name: MonarchCareersJobList
title: CareersJobList
summary: A list of open roles: a heading with the number of positions, one card per role, and the details of a role in a bottom sheet with its duties, requirements, skills, benefits and an apply button.
whenToUse: On a careers or recruiting screen of an app, such as the public jobs page of a recruiting product.
whenNotToUse: For an applicant pipeline or internal hiring views, use a list or table of the hiring data.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCareersJobList(jobs: List<MonarchCareerJob>, openJob: String?, onOpenJobChange: (String?) -> Unit, onApply: (MonarchCareerJob) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, columns: Int = 2, organizationName: String? = null, contactEmail: String? = null, labels: MonarchCareersJobListLabels = MonarchCareersJobListLabels())

class MonarchCareerJob(id: String, title: String, department: String? = null, location: String? = null, employmentType: String? = null, experience: String? = null, salary: String? = null, summary: String? = null, responsibilities: List<String> = emptyList(), qualifications: List<String> = emptyList(), mustHaveSkills: List<String> = emptyList(), niceToHaveSkills: List<String> = emptyList(), benefits: List<String> = emptyList(), applyLink: String? = null)

class MonarchCareersJobListLabels(title: String? = null, empty: String? = null, responsibilities: String? = null, qualifications: String? = null, mustHave: String? = null, niceToHave: String? = null, benefits: String? = null, apply: String? = null, applyByEmail: String? = null)

options.name: openJob
options.description: The id of the role whose details are shown, or null.

options.name: onOpenJobChange
options.description: Called with the id of the role the user opens, or null when the details close.

options.name: onApply
options.description: Called with the role when the user taps the apply button.

options.name: columns
options.description: The most cards per row on a wide screen; a card stays at least 288dp wide.

options.name: organizationName
options.description: The hiring organisation, in "Applying to …" above the apply button.

options.name: contactEmail
options.description: Where applications go by email; a role without applyLink shows "Apply by email".

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the heading, the empty message, the section headings and the apply buttons.

states.name: list
states.description: The heading, "N positions" and the cards.

states.name: empty
states.description: The heading and "No open roles right now. Check back soon." in a card.

states.name: details
states.description: A bottom sheet with the title, department and metadata, salary, summary, lists and the apply button.

appearance: Cards are MonarchCard on the surface with the default border; the department is the muted caption in capitals, the title the subheading, metadata, salary and summary the muted colour, skills MonarchTag. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web list opens the details in a dialog and offers "Email instead" beside the apply link and a mailto link. On Android the details are a MonarchBottomSheet with one apply button: "Apply now" for a role with an applyLink, "Apply by email" otherwise when contactEmail is set; onApply receives the role and the app opens its application flow or email. Cards are stacked on a phone.
accessibility: Each card is one button that opens the details; its title is a heading.
The department is read in the case it was given, not in capitals.
The details sheet has the role title, a close button and headings for each list.
edgeCases: The summary shows two lines on the card and in full in the details.
A role without applyLink and a list without contactEmail shows no apply button.
An openJob id that is not in jobs shows no details.

examples.title: Two columns with apply links and email
examples.setup:
var open by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
var applied by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
examples.code:
MonarchCareersJobList(
    jobs = listOf(
        MonarchCareerJob(
            id = "j1",
            title = "Product Designer",
            department = "Design",
            location = "Remote",
            employmentType = "Full time",
            experience = "3+ years",
            salary = "USD 90,000 – 120,000",
            summary = "Shape how teams plan and track their work, from research to shipped flows.",
            responsibilities = listOf("Design new flows end to end", "Run research sessions with customers"),
            qualifications = listOf("Three years of product design", "A portfolio of shipped work"),
            mustHaveSkills = listOf("Prototyping", "User research"),
            niceToHaveSkills = listOf("Motion design"),
            benefits = listOf("Learning budget", "Flexible hours"),
            applyLink = "apply-designer",
        ),
        MonarchCareerJob(
            id = "j2",
            title = "Support Specialist",
            department = "Customer support",
            location = "Lisbon",
            employmentType = "Part time",
            summary = "Help customers get the most out of the product.",
            mustHaveSkills = listOf("Written English", "Patience"),
        ),
        MonarchCareerJob(
            id = "j3",
            title = "Backend Engineer",
            department = "Engineering",
            location = "Hybrid · Berlin",
            employmentType = "Full time",
            summary = "Build the APIs that power scheduling and billing.",
            mustHaveSkills = listOf("TypeScript", "PostgreSQL"),
            applyLink = "apply-backend",
        ),
    ),
    openJob = open,
    onOpenJobChange = { open = it },
    onApply = { applied = it.id },
    organizationName = "Northwind",
    contactEmail = "jobs@example.com",
)

examples.title: No open roles
examples.code:
MonarchCareersJobList(
    jobs = emptyList(),
    openJob = open,
    onOpenJobChange = { open = it },
    onApply = {},
    labels = MonarchCareersJobListLabels(title = "Internships"),
)
